# Oppvera Watch Documentation

> Oppvera Watch is an educational fork of OneGlanse for learning GEO and AI visibility. These docs cover setup, configuration, and deployment.

## What is Oppvera Watch?

Oppvera Watch monitors how brands appear in real AI products — ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overview — using browser automation against the actual product UIs. It captures inline citations, ranked recommendations, brand framing, and competitor co-mentions that never appear in raw model API output.

It is open source (MIT), self-hosted, and free to run locally. All data stays on your own machine or VPS.

Based on [OneGlanse](https://github.com/aryamantodkar/oneglanse) by Aryaman Todkar.
